create_ADTMemoryProvider: create an ADTMemoryProvider instance with a config containing data_path, sequence_id, is_root, debug, and verbose fields
get_object_context: get object context and location from an ADT sequence using LLM or VLM based object search methods
create_owl_vit_retrieval_benchmark: create an Owl-ViT based object retrieval benchmark from ADT sequences with configurable depth and area thresholds
create_object_retrieval_benchmark: create an object retrieval benchmark by sampling sequences and objects with id or description based methods
test_provider: test the ADT memory provider by running the click CLI command with data-path, sequence-id, is-root, debug, and verbose options
